observed_facts.fact: The own site is a free Grexa template on kesari-custom.grexa.site, with no own domain and a 'Built by Grexa' footer.

The site claims 4.8 stars from 52+ Google reviews. The 10 reviews shown are dated 5 Apr to 11 Jul 2026, and none shows an owner reply on the site. This does not prove the Google listing has no replies.

The site shows hours 8am-8pm Mon-Sun and the address Mansarovar Rd near Hillook Hotel, Tragad, behind Zudio, Ahmedabad 382470. The search engine's cached copy of the same site shows other hours (10am-10pm) and '7+' ratings, so the data is auto-synced and moves.
No site or social profile found shows any owner or staff name, founding year, branches or project count.

hypotheses: The Grexa site is generated from the Google Business Profile, so it is not an independent second source. The business probably exists, but I could not confirm it from a second independent page.
Likely a small owner-run studio, since a free auto-site and 52+ reviews suggest little marketing spend. Not shown by any source.
The 4.8 rating from 52+ reviews suggests real demand. It is a weak ability-to-pay signal on its own.
The listing's website button probably points to the Grexa site, which would mean the Google profile has no real own site. Not verified, because the listing did not load.
A booking and proof page plus profile upkeep would fill a real gap here, but the gap is a free template with Enquire buttons, not a missing site.

dossier.case_for: Single-location owner-run studio, premium services (ceramic, PPF, wrap) that sell on trust and photos. Good rating (4.8, 52+ reviews). The site shows only a free template with Enquire buttons and no booking path, no WhatsApp button and no own domain. A published mobile number is present. It is not in the existing lead list.
dossier.case_against: Identity rests on one auto-generated page, with no second independent source, so it is unverifiable under the rule. No owner name, no social profile, no sign of Meta ads or other spend, so the pay signal is weak. The 'no owner reply' claim is not confirmed, because the site template may not show replies and the Google listing did not load. It is unknown who answers +91 9274582116. Some site details change between snapshots (hours, ratings), so the data is not stable. The finder's claim that the state is permanent is not supported: Grexa sites sync from the Google listing and can change.
dossier.size_cues: Single address, no branches, staff, years or project counts published. 52+ Google reviews (site claim). Small.
dossier.ability_to_pay: Weak and unproven. A 4.8 rating from 52+ reviews and premium PPF and coating services imply steady business, but no ad spend, no own domain and no team signals were found.
dossier.resistance: Low to moderate. The studio uses a free Grexa site, so it may see no need to pay for another page, and Grexa may bundle review or profile tools. Whether the owner answers the published number, or someone else does, is unknown.
dossier.best_angle: Not applicable while rejected. If re-opened: after checking the Google listing, offer to turn the Enquire-only free site into a booking and proof page with package prices by car size, before and after photos and a WhatsApp Book button. Do not claim lost bookings or missing owner replies unless seen on the listing.
dossier.best_channel: Do not contact yet. If re-opened: a human WhatsApp message or call to +91 9274582116, the only business-published number (source: the Contact page). Not confirmed to reach the owner.
